name: Kennock
text: Kennock is an English form of the name Mo Cháemóc. Mo Cháemóc was a disciple of the saint Patrick. In the tale of the Children of Lir he gives the Christian faith to the four children when their time of sorrow ends.

key_results: Give the fuller form of the name.
Name the master of the disciple.
